questions: Are the sensor positions optimal for curve detection and line tracking?
Is the chosen sensor size effective for reliable sensing without excessive noise?
Do the wheel track and radius provide good maneuverability and stability?

intent: The design uses a symmetric three-sensor array with wider outer sensors to enhance curve detection and maintain stability. The body dimensions and wheel parameters are chosen conservatively within bounds to ensure robust handling and balance. The sensor placement near the front center aids in precise line tracking.
